fields.name: admitted
docs: Issuer-control categories the market administrator admitted for this mint.

types.name: BaseLeg
docs: One whitelisted issuer token of the market's asset. Claims on a leg are
backed only by that issuer's token; legs never share collateral.

fields.name: scale
docs: 10^(decimals - share_decimals): raw issuer units per share unit at a
multiplier of one. Deliveries also divide by the live multiplier.

fields.name: multiplier
docs: Effective ScaledUiAmount multiplier (f64 bits, 1.0 if none) at listing.
A live multiplier outside the 4/5..5/4 band of it halts the leg.

types.name: Leg
docs: Up to this many share units of one planned maker. A maker filled, cancelled
or invalidated since planning is skipped; a partially filled one is capped.

fields.name: bases
docs: Listed base legs occupy collaterals 1..=bases.

fields.name: mints
docs: The four per-asset ledgers are heap vectors of exactly ASSETS entries
(see `Market::ledgers`), keeping every SBF frame that deserializes a
Market below 4 KiB. Their length never changes after creation.

fields.name: recent
docs: The last RECENT placements of each branch: branch b, sequence s at
`b * RECENT + s % RECENT` (the sequence is implied: within the window
each slot holds the latest placement mapping to it). Heap-sized like
the ledgers. Kept compact: the market is rewritten by every placement.

fields.name: fees
docs: Indexed by claim asset; underlying slots stay zero.

fields.name: delegate
docs: Zero for owner-signed orders; otherwise the immutable grant's signing key.

fields.name: data
docs: Complete final account image, including discriminator. Finalized replay
reconstructs historical orders even after their account rent is returned.

fields.name: bases
docs: Base-leg bitmask (bit i = collateral i + 1). A buy lists every issuer it
accepts; a sell names exactly the one issuer token it delivers.

types.name: Placement
docs: A placement as retained for race checks: its limit price in ticks of the
market (prices are tick multiples) and its side, `rules::SIDE_NONE` when
the order did not rest.

fields.name: next_sequence
docs: The branch sequence the plan observed: every planned maker is older.

fields.name: min_fill
docs: Least total fill that makes the placement worthwhile (e.g. one step for
immediate-or-cancel); fewer fillable makers fail it as stale.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 deposit (net received), 1 withdrawal (gross debited), 2 pool listed
(amount = admitted issuer-control categories).

fields.name: share_decimals
docs: Canonical share-unit decimals. Order quantities, step and max_quantity
are share units; a base leg with d decimals converts at 10^(d - share_decimals).

fields.name: base
docs: Base leg (collateral index) whose claims the buyer received.

fields.name: quantity
docs: Share units.

fields.name: base_amount
docs: Raw base-leg claim units delivered: floor(quantity * scale / live multiplier).

types.name: Trader
docs: Owner-wide invalidation across every market in this protocol deployment.
Never closed or reset when another market wallet is initialized.

fields.name: market
docs: Zero explicitly grants all markets in this config; otherwise one market.

fields.name: max_order_quote
docs: Raw quote-token units, charged at the submitted limit on BOTH sides.
